name: Fab 42

process_nodes.label: 7nm
process_nodes.note: Target process when Intel committed in 2017 to complete the fab; not the process reported in production.

summary: A high-volume logic fab on Intel's Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona. In February 2017 Intel committed more than $7 billion to complete the fab, then aimed at a 7nm process, within three to four years. Intel reported in March 2021 that Fab 42 had become fully operational in 2020, producing microprocessors on its 10nm processes.

milestones.note: Intel announced plans to complete the fab.
Intel reported the fab fully operational in 2020.
